_comment: Language-pack catalog (OPUS-MT; FREE tier since the operator ruling of 2026-09-01): pairs PATANYX offers from converted OPUS-MT models where Mozilla publishes none. Read by gen-language-registry.py (merged BELOW Mozilla: a token Mozilla publishes always wins) and by publish-langpacks.py's catalog mode. Conversion recipe and measurements: docs/opus-mt-spike.md; tools: scripts/opus-mt/. The  hashes PIN the exact artifact bytes that may be signed for each pair: the publisher refuses anything else, so an unrelated or tampered model cannot receive this pair's provenance and the trusted key.

upstream.licence_evidence: LICENSE file inside the release zip (Attribution 4.0 International)

pairs.conversion: aligned vocab (build-aligned-vocab.py --pad-to, validated against source-language text from the official Tatoeba test set) + pad-marian-vocab.py + marian-conv intgemm8 with alphas calibration; empty lex.bin (no shortlist); gemm-precision int8shiftAll (the alphas the calibration produced are IGNORED at run time: int8shiftAlphaAll computes wrongly on WebView2 and plain int8 measured equal or better on every pack once the vocabulary alignment was fixed); beam 1
